svg.title: Transform (sideways) · stage 1
svg.desc: Plates slide past each other. Ridges and streams that cross the boundary are offset sideways. Front face: no change; the crust keeps its thickness.
svg.text: Plates slide past each other. Ridges and streams that cross the boundary are offset sideways.
Front face: no change; the crust keeps its thickness.
Storyboard (7A), authored from the 7A table; not simulated; not production art. Heights, layers ×4; crust base ×0.75.
